Seasonal_dominated series with unstable ranking suggests a robust trimmed mean may outperform median or weighted.
test a different combination kind – a deterministic weighted scheme with softmax over negative errors to see if it improves over inverse_error.
Try a simple mean over the full pool, a different aggregation kind to compare against weighted and trimmed mean.
Ranking is unstable and several models cluster; a per‑horizon best‑model weighting may capture complementary strengths across the 13‑step horizon.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a robust DBA weighting might improve over weighted best_per_horizon.
Ranking is unstable and several correlated groups exist; a forward‐selection weight that greedily adds complementary models might capture the diversity better than static inverse or softmax weights.
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a per‑horizon top‑k mean may capture varying best models across horizons.
The series is seasonal_dominated with unstable ranking; a robust median over a small correlated group (pool4) may improve over weighted.
try a weighted combination on the smaller, top‑5 pool using inverse_error weights to see if a focused subset improves robustness.
seasonality_dominated and unstable ranking suggest a robust simple aggregation on a focused subset (pool4) may outperform full‑pool means; try mean(pool4).

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w5' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9055. Series context: trend strength 0.0 and seasonal strength 0.6419; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.131); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.404.
